ORCL (−8.8%), MRVL (−8.7%), HOOD (−8.5%), ALAB (−7.7%), ARM (−6.8%), SOFI (−6.7%), OKTA (−6.4%), SNOW (−6.3%) and AMD (−5.7%) led the drop. INTC (RSI 15), SOFI (13), HOOD (20), SNDK (21), MP and ARM (24) and MU (26) are deeply oversold, and MSFT (71) is the only name still overbought.
